summaries.text: Auditor Independence Act of 2002 - Amends the Securities Exchange Act of 1934to provide that an independent public accountant who performs auditing or related services for a client is prohibited from also providing to such client during the calendar year in which such services are performed: (1) management consulting services; (2) any other service that is not related to the audit; or (3) any other service that could result in a potential conflict of interest or otherwise impair auditor independence.
